programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Date With Destiny
programmes.d: Cleo discovers a comet is causing fish to flee the waters around Mako Island. The girls find a way to restart the message in the Moon Pool and discover the comet will collide with earth.

Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet and a planet wide catastrophe. Rikki, Cleo and Bella graduate with a surprise.
Cleo and Emma meet new girl, Rikki, and find themselves stuck on Mako Island where they are transformed into mermaids. As well as growing tails, the girls find they have powers over water.

Annoying Miss Popularity, Miriam, is having a pool party and the girls want to go. But being around water is risky, especially when Zane tosses Cleo into the pool. Lewis is the only one around to help so he finds out their secret.

Rikki, Emma and Cleo discover that sea turtles are being captured by fishing nets. When Rikki and Emma attempt to rescue the turtles by cutting the nets, it causes the fisherman to think that there is a rogue shark roaming their ocean.

Emma decides that she is not going to have her annual sleepover party due to what has happened to them. But Rikki and Cleo try to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Lewis conducts experiments on the girls.

No matter how hard Gus works on a shrinking formula for Potions Class, it comes out wrong. Frustrated, he thinks about cheating and turning in a commercially made one. Meanwhile, in the underground realm of the greedy Scavenger Imps.
Something strange is happening: knives can't cut butter, bramble bushes are becoming soft (even Gus's comic timing is off). When Cassy and Verne are sent into the mortie village to buy bread.

Someone is vandalizing the school. Meanwhile, Kasimir is behaving VERY strangely towards everyone, including Gus and Verne. A rift begins to form between them to the point that Gus would rather hang with the twins than Kasimir.
Guest teacher Master wizard Valentine dazzles the students with his wizardry. And after class he entices Cassy and Gus with tales of the Tear of Moolana.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

Cleo and Rikki push Ash into asking Emma out again – little did they know he’d turn up at Emma’s place in time for a full moon! Rikki and Cleo are both moonstruck and Ash looks set to discover Emma’s secret.
For the first anniversary of the girls being mermaids, Cleo decides to throw a party. However, Emma and Rikki fall out following a fight between Ash and Zane and Cleo may have to celebrate alone.

Lewis discovers someone called Max Hamilton did research fifty years ago on the strange properties of Mako Island. Lewis tracks the old man down and finds that he knows a lot more about mermaids than Lewis first thought.

Charlotte demands answers to why Lewis is hanging out with the girls so much. She believe an excuse from Cleo, but then a discovery from inside Max's research brings her to the secret! Meanwhile, Ash decides to help Emma with her fear of water.
An artistic girl's sketches take on a life of their own. Realizing her capability, she attempts to draw the perfect family.
Marshall and Simon think they've finally found someone who will believe them - a traveling professor of the 'parabelievable.' But should they be believing him?
Radical surf dudes Mike and Ben decide to take Ben's father's most bodacious speedboat for a spin without permission.
Ten year old Jimmy is afraid to sleep in the dark. / While digging in Greece, a greedy Fortune Hunter searches out the ancient cave ruins of the Greek legend Medusa.
It's a dark and stormy night when Mildred and Camille's car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.
A Mad Scientist went missing in the 1930's.
The BION team travel to London to bid on the Winged Warrior Helmet, said to give the wearer the strength of ten.
Rip finds in his uncle's diary details of a failed trip to Tibet, searching evidence of the Yeti.

When Cyril insists on being included in a strenuous weekend hike deep into the bush of Northern Quebec, using only Samuel de Champlain's Astrolabe to guide them, he ends up being chased by a ravenously hungry bear and getting lost.
Rip has just bought the Hand of Fatima, a legendary good luck totem, from a gypsy, when it's stolen by a young carny who believes its power can save his Family's New Jersey amusement park.
Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh'lainn Blaze...
A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss's holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest...
Battle Bladers begins but turns out Doji is in charge. Regardless, Benkei, Kenta, and Gingka beat their first opponents.
Hyoma must battle an unknown blader, Reiji from the Dark Nebula, who uses a Poison Serpent to take him down.
The gang nurse Hikaru to health after her defeat by Ryuga; Yu is forced to battle Reiji to see if he can stay with the Dark Nebula.

programmes.d: Reggie is obnoxious, self centered and sometimes downright cruel - especially when he scoffs at Archie's weird mysteries.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: It Lives in the Sewers
programmes.d: Betty is spooked in the middle of the night when she hears strange noises in her house.
Archie has a series of extremely pleasant dreams about a beautiful girl who adores him.
A new girl arrives at school and quickly catches Archie's attention.

'Lifestyles of the Pink and Famous': When valet Pinky saves the life of a zillionaire, he's given a million dollar reward. 'Happy Trails Pinky': Pinky's stage coach company is threatened by the transcontinental railroad and a not too bright robber.

'A Hard Days Pink': When Pinky's fairy god manager transforms five animals into a piano, Pinky tries to win the big battle of the bands contest. 'You Only Pink Twice': Secret agent Panther must deliver a top-secret valise to the president.

'It's Just a Gypsy in My Soup': Pinky fights off his boss, the Dogfather and a gypsy curse to become King of the Gypsy. 'Three Aliens and a Footstool': The Panther is captured by a group of aliens with Ikea-like designs on the people of earth.

'Mummy Dearest': The Panther opens the casket of Squawksalotta and is plagued by a talkative parrot who won't give him any peace. 'Feast or Famine': The Panther must choose between eating or saving a friendly lobster from a maniacal chef.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.

Mr. Bean, badgered by a strange pink animal, warms to the creature when it shows its true colours. Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms.
When invited to dinner by Mr. Bean, it’s probably best to take your own sandwiches. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven.
Mr. Bean makes it to the top of the ladder… and gets stuck. The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road.

Mr. Bean bites off more than he can chew when he attempts DIY dentistry. Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell.
It is field trip time as Sabrina’s class heads toward Monument Island where an important statue is kept.
